description: 2x2 rib where every row, including row 1, repeats to the end. The pattern has no cast-on count, so Ply cannot count any row: each gets a warning stating the multiple it works over (row 1's also points at the cast-on setting), and the written rows stay exact. rib-cast-on-flat is the same chart with a cast-on.
covers: ToEnd on the first row (unknown count)

rows.written: Row 1 (RS): k, *k2, p2; rep from * to last st, k
Row 2 (WS): p, *k2, p2; rep from * to last st, p

issues.message: row 1: the repeat over cols 2-5 is worked to the end of the row, but the pattern has no cast-on count, so Ply cannot count this row (it needs a multiple of 4 stitches plus 2); set the cast-on in the pattern settings
row 2: the repeat over cols 2-5 is worked to the end of the row, but the stitch count after row 1 is unknown, so Ply cannot count this row (it needs a multiple of 4 stitches plus 2)
